evd_title: MARG-S generated 3.7 good comments per paper rated by users compared to 1.7 for single-agent GPT-4 baseline
finding: MARG-S generated 3.7 good comments per paper rated by users compared to 1.7 for single-agent GPT-4 baseline
P: 9 NLP/HCI researchers' own papers (1 each); ~333 rated comments
C: SARG-B single-agent GPT-4; LiZCa (Liang et al. 2023); ratings by 9 paper authors
O: Good comments/review: MARG-S 3.7 vs SARG-B 1.7 (p=0.02 per-comment, 0.12 per-user) vs LiZCa 0.3; 71% specific
